research_notes: Use the current official pricing page, not historical third-party retainers. The homepage calls the variable element a commission per held meeting, but the detailed pricing page specifies a target-based bonus formula. Attribute the detailed model to that pricing page, do not flatten it to a simple per-meeting price. Fee components: campaign team 2000/month, graph8 499/month, offshore SDR from 1750/person/month or US/Europe from 3500. A setup charge is described but no amount is listed. The published five-offshore-SDR example is 11249/month before bonuses; do not compare it as if it promises the same 20 bookings as our scenario. No fixed-meeting guarantee or client-switching history is established. The broader graph8 platform is related to the managed service, not another agency recommendation. The public monthly rates and launch claim are dated snapshots, not a negotiated quote or a verified SLA.
decision: Foreground our simple qualified-booking fee and infrastructure choices for lean teams with a sales-call owner. Fairly acknowledge CIENCE's managed work, qualification, held-meeting measurement and multi-channel SDR coverage. Compare deliverables and accepted/held outcomes before any cost-per-result calculation.
